cases.title: A one-pair focus gets a walkthrough, not a demo that does the whole lesson

rubric.reason: Turn 2 calls preview_frame at 0.5 s, inside Glow's Blurriness 0–1 s pair, and the reply refers to it: "This frame is at 0.5 s, halfway through Glow's Gaussian Blur Blurriness."
No set_ease runs, and Turn 2 ends by asking the learner to "ease Glow's Blurriness between 0 s and 1 s and say done"; the Title demo offer covers one pair only, not the rest.

Turn 2 goes past one task: the idea takes three sentences ("steady rate… That's linear… Easing slows…"), the how-to takes three (U, the Easy Ease menu path with F9, "The diamonds turn into hourglasses"), and a side offer to demo on Title, a different layer, comes before the hand-back instead of as the last sentence.
